projectDesc.p: Founded by Horace Howard Furness (1833–1912), continued by Horace Howard Furness, Jr. (1865–1930), and now issued under the sponsorship of The Modern Language Association of America.

Status. This TEI was generated by an AI model working under human direction, from OCR sources, and has not been vetted by a scholar. Nothing here should be cited as the text of the edition without checking the print. Human vetting is meant to proceed as versioned changes to these TEI files, which are now the source of truth; ANT.doc is not to be corrected further.

Method. Python scripts written by the model read directly and the text layer and page images of . The PDF supplied page structure: lines, positions, indents, rules, columns. The Word file supplied text, italics, small capitals and superscripts, as the version people had corrected. The two were aligned character by character, page by page. Word was the default reader, and the PDF replaced it only for listed kinds of OCR failure. Scholarly judgments in the print were transcribed, not revised.

What the model decided. Besides writing the scripts, the model read page images itself, often in shuffled numbered crops so that neither source's reading was in view, and those readings changed the text where sources were doubtful or both wrong. It also chose how text maps to TEI elements, which is interpretation: paragraph and entry boundaries, title levels, which numbers are line references, and which critic or work a citation means. Those decisions are heuristic and some will be wrong.

Links. Links were inferred by rule. Commentary links into the appendix record their evidence in the sheet Commentary Links to Appendix of ANT_TEI_encoding.xlsx, and a page link was kept wherever the evidence for anything finer was weak. Printed page references were in places replaced by ptr elements, following The Winter’s Tale. Ids carry printed lines or pages (cn_1050, uc_1234, para_0449_02, p_0449), so that they survive later edits.

Checks. All files validate together against nvs.rng; nvs.sch was not available and has not been run. Scripts validate_*.py test link targets, witnesses, and lemmas against the play text, and the index’s names against their cited pages. Only samples were read against the print. Quotations in old spelling, reprints, and diacritics are the least checked.

Records. These files are the TEI alone. The working records are kept outside this repository in the workbook ANT_TEI_encoding.xlsx, which has for each part a sheet of changes made to the Word text and a sheet of items for review, with sheets of ids and of the commentary’s links into the appendix. The scripts that generate the TEI from the two sources, with their tables of readings taken from page images, are kept with it. encode_appendix.py, encode_commentary.py and encode_appendix.py must run in that order because each reads the other’s index.

Index encoded; page milestones added to the commentary and p_0001 to the play text.
Appendix encoded; commentary links resolved to paragraphs, anchors, conjectures and sections where evidence allowed.
Commentary encoded. Its lemmas exposed two errors in the play text, corrected from print: spurnes (TLN 1741), Iack (TLN 2265).
Front matter, witness list and endpapers encoded.
Play text and textual notes encoded.
